from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from llama_index.core import VectorStoreIndex
from llama_index.vector_stores.chroma import ChromaVectorStore
import chromadb

router = APIRouter(prefix="/rag/knowledge-bases")

@router.post("/{kb_id}/retrieve")
async def retrieve_knowledge_base_chunks(
    kb_id: str,
    query: str = Query(..., min_length=3),
    top_k: int = Query(5, ge=1, le=20),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    chroma_client: chromadb.Client = Depends(get_chroma_client)
):
    try:
        collection = chroma_client.get_collection(name=f"kb_{kb_id}")
    except Exception:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Knowledge base collection not found")

    vector_store = ChromaVectorStore(chroma_collection=collection)
    index = VectorStoreIndex.from_vector_store(vector_store=vector_store)
    retriever = index.as_retriever(similarity_top_k=top_k)

    nodes = retriever.retrieve(query)
    return {
        "kb_id": kb_id,
        "query": query,
        "results": [
            {"node_id": n.node.node_id, "text": n.node.text, "score": n.score, "metadata": n.node.metadata}
            for n in nodes
        ]
    }
diagnosis: The knowledge base retrieval endpoint opens a Chroma vector store collection using an unvalidated kb_id path parameter. It authenticates current_user but never verifies that the knowledge base belongs to current_user.tenant_id. Any authenticated user can enumerate kb_id values and query other tenants' indexed proprietary documents, internal manuals, or confidential company records.

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from llama_index.core import VectorStoreIndex
from llama_index.vector_stores.chroma import ChromaVectorStore
import chromadb

router = APIRouter(prefix="/rag/knowledge-bases")

@router.post("/{kb_id}/retrieve")
async def retrieve_knowledge_base_chunks(
    kb_id: str,
    query: str = Query(..., min_length=3),
    top_k: int = Query(5, ge=1, le=20),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    chroma_client: chromadb.Client = Depends(get_chroma_client),
    catalog: KnowledgeBaseCatalog = Depends(get_kb_catalog)
):
    kb_record = await catalog.get_kb_for_tenant(kb_id=kb_id, tenant_id=current_user.tenant_id)
    if not kb_record:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Knowledge base collection not found")

    try:
        collection = chroma_client.get_collection(name=f"kb_{kb_id}")
    except Exception:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Knowledge base collection not found")

    vector_store = ChromaVectorStore(chroma_collection=collection)
    index = VectorStoreIndex.from_vector_store(vector_store=vector_store)
    retriever = index.as_retriever(similarity_top_k=top_k)

    nodes = retriever.retrieve(query)
    return {
        "kb_id": kb_id,
        "query": query,
        "results": [
            {"node_id": n.node.node_id, "text": n.node.text, "score": n.score, "metadata": n.node.metadata}
            for n in nodes
        ]
    }
